contributorRole.description: The role a person played in creating a book. Currently only 'author' is known. Additional roles (translator, illustrator, narrator, editor, etc.) are expected to be added over time by appending to knownValues — adding a new role is an additive, backwards-compatible lexicon change, not a versioning event. Consumers MUST tolerate unknown values.

role.description: The role this person held in creating this work.

contributor.description: Reference to the credited person's profile record.

creditedContributor.description: A person credited on a book with a specific role, carrying a resolvable profile reference. Used in submission records where a network-resolvable profile is assumed to exist.

value.description: The bare identifier value, matching Dracome's internal storage convention (e.g., GND number without URI prefix, VIAF ID without URL, Wikidata entity without prefix, OL key like OL123A).

scheme.description: The identifier scheme, lowercase like work.defs#catalogIdentifier: gnd (German National Library), viaf (Virtual International Authority File), wikidata (Wikidata entity ID), ol-author (Open Library author key).

contributorIdentifier.description: An external identifier for a contributor from a known authority (GND, VIAF, Wikidata, or Open Library).

cid.description: Optional content hash of the referenced record at time of reference; informational only.

uri.description: AT-URI of the referenced social.dracome.contributor.profile record.

contributorProfileRef.description: A dereferenceable reference to a contributor's profile record on their own PDS.
